hypothesis: Current-season zone-specific carries and targets allocate a team touchdown forecast more stably than individual historical touchdown counts.
formula: lambda = (sum player opportunity conversion mass / sum team opportunity conversion mass) * 0.5 * (team earlier offensive TD per game + opponent earlier offensive TD allowed per game); P(ATD)=1-exp(-lambda)
opportunity_mass: Designed carry/target counts in yard-line zones1,2,3-5,6-10,11-20,21+ multiplied by fixed development league conversion rates; kneels/spikes/no-plays/2PT excluded. Verified positive offensive participation establishes an observed zero; omitted rows are unknown.
eligibility: Current-season only; >=3 complete prior player/team opportunity observations and >=3 opponent defensive observations; exact player/current team; all dates strictly before decision and target; receipt clock<=decision; source max24h; played-through availability cohort limitation explicit.

historical_plan.fit: 2021-2023 development for any added coefficients only; fixed inherited zone rates already use2019-2023
historical_plan.diagnostic_test: 2025 reused retrospective, no untouched holdout claim
historical_plan.sealed: Do not read or score2026ABBEYS holdout outcomes
historical_plan.future_gate: Prospective newly frozen ATD opportunities/availability/quote receipt and later outcomes; no retrospective backfill

comparators: intact actual two-sided sportsbook de-vigged prices where available
acceptance.gain: Brier improvement>=0.002 with game/player clustered upper95%CI of challenger-minus-Champion below0 and nonworsening logloss; future prospective replication required beforepromotion
acceptance.edge: No edge claim without independent identical-sample market comparison and prospective execution/settlement receipts

missingness: Missing per-game zone/team/opponent observations reject; no aggregate current snapshot backfill, no inferred player alignment, no fabricated zero, no historical median fill.
